verdicts.reason: A: the Meridian logo sits on the busy hillside photo and its final 'n' runs into the panel edge. The 'UP TO 40% OFF' badge is squashed into a distorted ellipse and crammed against an undersized Find a Fare button. The sunglasses are moved onto the panel as an odd header graphic, and the panel's top is jammed against the canvas edge. B: the logo also sits on the photo, but it is clear of the panel. The panel bleeds off the top and right edges and leaves a large dead area. The badge stays a circle but its text is too small to read, and the sunglasses are shrunk to a stray fragment straddling the panel's bottom edge. Neither is shippable, but B keeps the badge's proportions and the headline hierarchy cleaner.
